gancho: Le pidió matrimonio… con el anillo de otra

escenas: Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Characters: DIEGO (30, short black hair, white dress shirt), MARIANA (28, long straight black hair, red dress), SOFÍA (27, waitress, hair in a bun, black uniform with name tag). Diego kneels beside the table and opens a small velvet ring box toward Mariana, who covers her mouth in surprise. Slow push-in. Diego says: "Mariana, ¿te quieres casar conmigo?"

Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Characters: DIEGO (30, short black hair, white dress shirt), MARIANA (28, long straight black hair, red dress), SOFÍA (27, waitress, hair in a bun, black uniform with name tag). Nearby diners turn and smile. Mariana, with happy tears, nods while Diego slides the ring onto her finger. Mariana says: "¡Sí! ¡Claro que sí, mi amor!"

Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Close-up: Mariana admires the ring, tilts it and notices an engraving inside. Her smile slowly fades. Mariana says: "Diego… aquí dice «Para Sofía»."

Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Diego stands up with a nervous laugh and reaches for the ring. Diego says: "Es un error del joyero, te lo juro."

Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Sofía the waitress approaches with a champagne tray and freezes when she sees the ring. Mariana reads Sofía's name tag. Mariana says: "¿Sofía? ¿Tú eres Sofía?"

Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Sofía slowly sets the tray on the table, staring coldly at Diego. Sofía says: "Sí. Y ese mismo anillo me lo dio a mí ayer."

Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Characters: DIEGO (30, short black hair, white dress shirt), MARIANA (28, long straight black hair, red dress), SOFÍA (27, waitress, hair in a bun, black uniform with name tag). Sofía raises her hand showing an identical ring on her finger. Diners gasp. Diego goes pale. Mariana says: "¿Dos anillos iguales, Diego? ¿Dos propuestas?"

Elegant candle-lit restaurant at night, other diners at nearby tables. Characters: DIEGO (30, short black hair, white dress shirt), MARIANA (28, long straight black hair, red dress), SOFÍA (27, waitress, hair in a bun, black uniform with name tag). Mariana and Sofía look at each other, then both drop their rings into Diego's champagne glass. Sofía says: "Quédatelos. Nosotras nos vamos juntas."
